description: The figure shows two side-by-side horizontal bar charts illustrating inference time cost (in minutes) for the MATH task across five methods for two models, with the left panel titled “Marco-o1-7B” and the right panel titled “QwQ-32B-Preview.” In each panel, the category axis is the vertical axis (categories indicated by the color legend rather than on-axis labels) and the bars are arranged from top to bottom as Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, and O1-Pruner; the value axis is the horizontal axis labeled “Inference Time (minute)” on a linear scale. For Marco-o1-7B, the x-axis runs from 0 to 2.5 with tick marks every 0.5, and the bars are approximately: Baseline (light green) a little above 2.1 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow) about 2.1 minutes, SFT (gray) about 2.1 minutes, DPO (orange) about 2.1 minutes, and O1-Pruner (blue) about 1.1 minutes. For QwQ-32B-Preview, the x-axis runs from 0 to 7 with tick marks every 1, and the bars are approximately: Baseline (light green) about 6.1 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow) about 5.0 minutes, SFT (gray) about 5.8–5.9 minutes, DPO (orange) about 5.6 minutes, and O1-Pruner (blue) about 4.0 minutes. No bars appear visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors, and the ordering appears fixed by method rather than sorted by value.
